Examination Related Services

Office of the Controller of Examinations

The COE Office works closely with faculties, departments, and academic committees to uphold fairness, transparency, and academic excellence in all assessment processes.

Student Support Services, MTA Bhaban, Room#206, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

The Office of the Controller of Examinations (COE) oversees all examination and assessment activities at BUBT. It works closely with faculties, departments, and academic committees to ensure fairness, transparency, and the maintenance of academic standards in all evaluation processes.

Services of Our Office

Examination Policies and Guidelines

The Semester Mid-term, Final, and Supplementary examinations are conducted in each semester as per the academic calendar schedule. The Office of the CoE prepares the examination schedule in consultation with the concerned departmental Head and publishes it on the BUBT website.

Grading Policy and others

BUBT follows a semester-based system with Spring and Fall semesters, and the medium of instruction for teaching, learning, and examinations is English. Each course is evaluated on a 100-mark scale through attendance, continuous assessment, mid-term, and final examinations, with weightage varying by program. Student performance is measured using letter grades and grade points, calculated as SGPA and CGPA based on credit hours.

Certificates (Application Procedure)

The Certificates (Application Procedure) section outlines the eligibility, application process, required documents, and fees for obtaining academic certificates from BUBT. It also explains the application tracking and collection procedures to ensure a smooth and transparent service for students and graduates.

Transcript (Forms and Application Procedure)

Eligible students or graduates may apply for transcripts, course grades, academic progress reports, or certificate verification through ANNEX or the designated online platforms. Prescribed fees must be paid online or at the BUBT Accounts Section, and applicants can track application status through the respective systems. Documents are issued upon notification and collected by submitting the official delivery slip or in person where applicable.
